headline: RBI Governor meets UCB CEOs; stresses governance, cybersecurity and grievance redressal
summary_points: RBI Governor met Chairpersons and MD & CEOs of select Urban Cooperative Banks across tiers in Mumbai on November 23, 2026.
Governor noted credit growth in the UCB sector has improved, while profitability growth has lagged.
Stressed stronger governance, prudent lending with regard to borrowers' repayment capacity, and robust cybersecurity frameworks.
Urged UCBs to use Mission SAKSHAM training fully and maintain high standards of customer centricity and internal grievance redressal.
who_is_affected: Urban Cooperative Banks of all tiers, their boards and senior management, and their compliance and risk teams.
action_required: UCBs should review governance, lending, cybersecurity and grievance redressal practices against the Governor's stated priorities and enrol staff in Mission SAKSHAM.

social.linkedin:
RBI Governor meets Urban Cooperative Banks

On November 23, 2026, the RBI Governor met Chairpersons and MDs & CEOs of select UCBs across tiers in Mumbai, along with representatives of NAFCUB and NUCFDC. Deputy Governors and senior RBI officers also attended.

Key messages:

- Credit growth in the sector has improved, but profitability growth has lagged.
- Strengthen governance standards and lend prudently, with due regard to borrowers' repayment capacity.
- Put robust cybersecurity frameworks in place, as cyber risk affects banks of every size.
- Make full use of Mission SAKSHAM, the RBI's training initiative for UCBs.
- Maintain customer centricity and high standards of internal grievance redressal.

This is a meeting note and not a new directive, but it signals supervisory priorities for the UCB sector. Finance teams, auditors and advisors working with UCBs may wish to factor these themes into reviews.

Please verify details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1553).
